title: Working at Citi: See what it's like to work in Customer Service
description: Find out more about Customer Service job opportunities at Citi and hear from our employees as they share some of their innovative work and projects that help shape progress around the world.  View other Citi videos: http://www.youtube.com/citi Read our Blog: http://blog.citigroup.com Like us on Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/citi Follow us on Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/citi Follow us on LinkedIn: http://www.linkedin.com/company/citi Follow us on Instagram: http://www.instagram.com/citi Follow us on Google+: http://www.google.com/+citi

asr.full_text: Thank you for calling Citibank. Thank you very much for calling Citibank. My job here is awesome. It's fantastic. I love going home knowing that I've made a difference in someone's life. What makes City a great place to work is having the opportunity right after being hired to really try new things. It's very fun, exciting and you have plenty of growth opportunities here being such a large company Since I've been here I've had the opportunity to be in a leadership role with a morale committee. I have had the opportunity to pilot a whole new department. CiTI is a great place to work because of all the managers and your team members. They're willing to help you become a better you. Citea is a great place to work. as I love the benefits. Just getting benefits on the first day you work here is just a big thing in general. So it's a really good place that takes care of their employees and it really makes you feel like you're cared for. It's cool. City is a great place to work while you're in college. It's got flexible hours and tuition reimbursement. It's fast paced you're kept busy but it also has an amazing culture of volunteerism and continued growth and and improvement, and there's a very positive feel in the building. The culture is focused on a team environment. I would describe this environment as a really positive environment, where you get help from people and everyone's uplifting, and there's just opportunities to just be recognized. Yes it's a call center. But you can take all of your call center stereotypes and throw them out the window. I mean, Citi is doing it right, they really do care about the employees and the clients and they're here to make a difference in everyone's lives. It's one of the only jobs I can say that I really do love my job and coming to work. Over the past 205 years Citi has built a respected and trusted brand across the globe by providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. In addition, you will find that we are committed to providing development opportunities for our people. And you will discover that you have not only come into a dynamic and rewarding environment, but an inclusive and engaging one as well.
